steps.content: Donald strides over the scattered monsters into the depths of the maze. He sees the man in a suit lying on the ground. His umbrella has a hole in it, but his body has vanished.
Donald wanders around to inspect the scene closely. Not far away, the runes on the ground are completely destroyed, as if someone has struggled violently here.
Donald recognizes these are the runes used by the Underground to bind and torture prisoners. Fortunately, the victim has escaped, but it's a shame that he didn't get to meet that person first.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Impressive. Of course, she's an ally recommended by that person. Now once she finds Samuel and hands him the item, the mission is considered done. Sigh... Hopefully she won't charge too much. I've spent all my money on ${PlayerName} recently, can't afford it.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: The FAC's been a great help. This at least is a silver lining. You're lucky to still have these people on your side, ${PlayerName}. Once you wake up, be sure to keep a good relationship with them.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: After all, I saved your life. Your connections are my connections, haha.

Donald fires a shot into the air, choosing one out of the four rendezvous points. He informs Samuel that the rest is up to him. Donald needs to return to the FAC squad and say a few last words to his bodyguards before sneaking away.
The target has been achieved, but the expressions of the soldiers are far from relaxed.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: He's confirmed to be the target provided by the 9th Agency, Parma, the Underground executive. According to the MBCC Chief's operation report, he fanned the flames of BR-004, BR-001, and even the contamination in the gangs' crypt. He must be behind BR-002's unusual behavior as well.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: The contamination is still worsening... Striking him once is not enough. He is likely still alive. Search for this man, and more importantly, destroy all the sorcery.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Our understanding of the Underground's Mania is limited. We may have missed something somewhere. Search carefully! We're running out of time!
Yeah, we're running out of time. I need to go too. I appreciate your help, buddies. If everything goes smoothly, all our problems can be solved. Just don't die before then.
With that thought, Donald smiles and steps forward.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Alright guys, I've led the way and found the person you were looking for. I just remembered the blanket I left out to dry. If it gets dirty in the dust, I'll have to wash it again.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I'm heading back then, see ya!
The busy officer pauses to look at Donald.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Please wait. We have a few questions we would like to ask you. The Commander-in-Chief specifically gave me this task.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: ...Wow, should I be proud?

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: The eccentric Executive Officer, Hush X's informant, or should I say... the former leader of Rustfire who surrendered to Nirvana? You're also in contact with the Underground, right? Your understanding of their sorcery far exceeds what's been officially disclosed.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: ...Do you know where Chief ${PlayerName} is?
Looks like he can't sneak off easily this time.
